content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a service that enables digital creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly for their digital products. Unlike conventional payment platforms that impose hefty fees and require extensive verification processes, crypto gateways like NOWPayments facilitate seamless transactions with minimal costs. For instance, while platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% per sale, NOWPayments operates at a mere 0.5% fee. This significant reduction in fees allows creators to retain more revenue, enabling them to reinvest in their craft and grow their businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway integrates with a digital commerce stack to automate transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the gateway processes the payment, converting it into the appropriate cryptocurrency. The transaction is then verified on the blockchain, ensuring security and transparency. For digital creators, this means instant payment confirmation and automatic product delivery via platforms like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This infrastructure not only simplifies the sales process but also enhances the creator's control over their digital assets, allowing them to operate independently of restrictive platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where major payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. Individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products in countries like Ghana, Kenya, and Venezuela can benefit immensely from crypto payment gateways. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can bypass the limitations imposed by traditional financial systems and reach a global audience. Empowered by the ability to accept cryptocurrency, these creators can fully monetize their skills and unlock new revenue streams.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with crypto payment gateways.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a crypto payment gateway relies on several key components. First, a reliable hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the foundation for the online store. Next, a backend logic layer, managed by tools such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, automates payment processing and order management. Additionally, NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring low fees and quick confirmations. Together, these elements create a robust and efficient infrastructure that allows digital creators to manage their sales with confidence.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying a crypto payment gateway, first choose a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script for automation. Integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions and set up your product catalog. Ensure you have proper documentation and support by utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment. Finally, launch your store and start selling your digital products without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, enabling automated transactions and product delivery. By setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack, you ensure low fees and retain full ownership of your sales infrastructure.
Say goodbye to platform restrictions and hello to ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads while avoiding platform fees, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides essential blueprints and templates to help you build a robust digital store powered by crypto payments.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
